body:
# Highlights

*1007 PRs from 257 contributors.*

## New models

| Model | Type | Cookbook |
|---|---|---|
| Muse Spark Open | LLM / VLM | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/Meta/MuseSparkOpen) |
| Beam-1.0 | LLM / VLM | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/Reflection/Beam-1_0) |
| MiniMax-M3.1-Flash | LLM / VLM | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/MiniMax/MiniMax-M3.1) |
| MiniCPM-V 4.7 | LLM / VLM | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/OpenBMB/MiniCPM-V-4_7) |
| Kev | LLM / VLM | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/Kev/kev) |
| Cosmos3-Nano-Sim (Bimanual, Transfer, Auto) | Diffusion | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/diffusion/Cosmos/Cosmos3) |
| FastH3 Omni | Diffusion | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/diffusion/MiniMax/MiniMax-H3) |
| FLUX.3 Image Klein | Diffusion | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/diffusion/FLUX/FLUX.3) |
| HY-Nomas | Diffusion | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/diffusion/HY-Nomas/HY-Nomas) |
| MOSS-Image | Diffusion | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/diffusion/OpenMOSS/MOSS-Image) |

## What's new

* DeepSeek-V4.1 on GB300 gets up to 1.5x more prefill throughput under load and about 28% lower first-token latency on 32K to 64K prompts ([#44403](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44403), [#45059](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45059), [#45107](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45107)).
* SGLang low-latency mode: the opt-in NVIDIA [megakernel](https://github.com/sgl-project/sgl-nvidia-mega) and AMD [monokernel](https://github.com/sgl-project/sgl-amd-mono) plugins run DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash decode as fused persistent kernels, for up to 44% faster single-user decode on GB300 and 75% on MI350X ([#44945](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44945), [#45450](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45450), [#44353](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44353), [#44621](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44621)).
* MoE models such as DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, GLM-5.3-Flash and gpt-oss reach the first token 30% to 58% sooner on 8K prompts on H200 ([#43363](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43363)).
* Paged Experts (opt-in) runs MoE models larger than GPU memory on a single consumer GPU, up to 30x faster than CPU offload ([#42557](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42557), [#45787](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45787)).
* SGLang now runs on Google TPU7x through [SGLang-TorchTPU](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang-torchtpu), a PyTorch-native plugin for TPU.
* You can now serve LoRA adapters on quantized MoE models (FP8 and NVFP4) with a new opt-in LoRA engine ([#45892](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45892)).
* DeepSeek-style MLA models running decode context parallelism can now keep their prefix cache in HiCache file-based L3 storage ([#41187](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41187)).

## To upgrade

```bash
uv pip install --prerelease=allow sglang==0.5.23
```

| Platform | Docker |
|---|---|
| NVIDIA (CUDA 13) | `docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.23` |
| AMD MI35x | `docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.23-rocm10-mi35x` |
| AMD MI30x | `docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.23-rocm10-mi30x` |
| Intel GPU | `docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.23-xpu` |
| Intel CPU | `docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.23-xeon` |
| Google TPU7x (TorchTPU) | `docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.1.0-tpu` |

# Full Release Notes

## Speculative Decoding

* [Feat] speculative: Seed rejection-sampling draft proposals for deterministic inference: [#33395](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/33395)

* [Fix] deepseek-v4.1: Keep the DSpark draft SWA out of the radix tree: [#44673](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44673)

* [Perf] attention: Capture translated FA4 verify metadata for DSPARK: [#44973](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44973)
* [Fix] deepseek-v4.1: Start the PD decode draft SWA window at the prefill draft valid-from: [#45037](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45037)
* [Fix] spec: Remove `--speculative-skip-dp-mlp-sync`: [#45043](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45043)
* [Feat] spec: Let out-of-tree platforms provide their own speculative worker: [#45144](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45144)
* [Feat] spec: Let out-of-tree platforms provide EAGLE draft graph runners: [#45145](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45145)
* [Fix] mamba: Skip zero-width conv pools in the MTP verify scatter: [#45212](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45212)
* [Fix] deepseek-v4: Keep the draft MoE out of the target's expert placement: [#45299](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45299)
* [Perf] [NVIDIA] dspark: Move the host work between DSv4.1 decode graphs into the graphs for the megakernel path: [#45450](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45450)
* [Feat] HiCache: Support fused DFLASH KV in unified hybrid SWA pools: [#45700](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45700)
* [Perf] gemma4: Capture single-step frozen-KV drafts (Gemma 4 E2B median TPOT 33% lower at concurrency 1 on H200): [#45771](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45771)
* [Perf] dsv41: Trim per-step DSpark decode overhead: [#46176](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46176)
* [Feat] spec: Support CUDA attention DP for DFlash and DFlash2: [#46330](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46330)
* [Perf] [NVIDIA] kda: Narrower V tiles for the KDA spec-verify recurrence on SM107: [#46465](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46465)
* [Perf] [NVIDIA] kimi-k3: Route draft/dense bf16 GEMMs to TGV and narrow the MLA output gate vector: [#46468](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46468)

* Qwen3.5, Qwen3.6 and Qwen3.8: Qwen3.5 MI355X FP8 agentic tuning with HiCache write-through, an RTX Spark Qwen3.6 NVFP4 recipe, Ascend A3 scenarios for Qwen3.6, FP8 KV and the QSA indexer by default for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, and the released Qwen3.8-Max W4A8 checkpoint on Ascend: [#46017](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46017), [#46032](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46032), [#44707](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44707), [#38678](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38678), [#45245](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45245), [#45574](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45574)
* Jais 3: a new page (runs on the K2 Horizon architecture): [#42766](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42766)
* Ornith-1.5: a new page (runs on the Qwen3.5 architectures): [#45455](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45455)
* New pages for models that run on preview images in this release: Ling-3.1-flash ([#44301](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44301), [#44307](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44307)), Nemotron 3.5 Super VL ([#44510](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44510), [#44587](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44587)), Step 5 Preview ([#44357](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44357)) and Recursive Flint: [#45625](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45625)
* TPU: the README and TPU guide introduce SGLang-TorchTPU next to SGL-JAX: [#45246](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45246)
* Ascend NPU docs move to CANN 9.1.0: [#44177](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44177), [#44432](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44432), [#44695](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44695)

## Dependencies

* FlashInfer 0.7.1 to 0.7.2: [#44591](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44591)
* sglang-kernel 0.4.9 to 0.4.10 ([#43922](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43922)), sgl-deep-gemm 0.2.2 to 0.2.3 ([#44666](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44666)) and then 0.2.3.post2 ([#45933](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45933)), and the new sgl-flash-mla 1.0.0: [#45893](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45893)
* New dependencies: deepseek-recipe 0.2.0 for DeepSeek-V4 / V4.1 chat ([#45315](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45315)) and tml-renderers 0.1.0 for Inkling chat: [#45340](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45340)
* `tokenspeed_mla` is no longer installed ([#44803](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44803)) and `cuda-tile` is dropped: [#44393](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44393)
* OpenAI SDK 2.6.1 to 2.8.0 ([#45291](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45291)), uvicorn >= 0.51 ([#45482](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45482)), timm 1.0.16 to 1.0.25 ([#46620](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46620)), python-dateutil < 3 to keep botocore resolvable ([#45857](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45857)), and sgl-eval 0.1.3: [#44131](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44131)
* Docker: CUDA images ship the sgl-nvidia-mega megakernel plugin, inert unless `--enable-nvidia-megakernel` is set ([#44945](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44945), [#46030](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46030)); AWS EFA image variants ([#41006](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41006)) and `numactl` in runtime images for `SGLANG_NUMA_BIND_V2`: [#43883](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43883)
* ROCm: a ROCm 10.1 image for gfx1250 alongside ROCm 10.0 ([#42699](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42699)), the sgl-amd-mono monokernel plugin in the ROCm image ([#44621](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44621), [#45389](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45389)), AITER pins `2bb549102` ([#44379](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44379)) and `285579b62` for gfx942 / gfx950 ([#45498](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45498)), and Mooncake v0.3.14-rc1 for cross-node KV transfer: [#44404](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44404)
* XPU: oneAPI 2026.1.3 and sglang-kernel-xpu 0.4.0 to 0.5.0: [#43989](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43989)
* MLX: mlx >= 0.32.4: [#44367](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44367)
* T-HEAD SAIL: a new `srt_sail` extra (in `pyproject_other.toml`) for the initial platform support: [#43826](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43826)

## Breaking Changes & Upgrade Notes

* **DeepSeek-V4 and V4.1 chat now follows deepseek-recipe.** Prompts, outputs and the native `/separate_reasoning` and `/parse_function_call` endpoints go through DeepSeek's official encoder, and SGLang's own `encoding_dsv4.py` / `encoding_dsv41.py` are gone. Clients may notice: streamed tool-call arguments arrive in pieces (the first chunk carries `arguments: ""`), so concatenate them as the OpenAI SDK does; tool-call ids use the official `call_00_...` format; V4 reasoning effort follows DeepSeek's official profile and the `dsv4_reasoning_effort_profile` override is removed; a numeric `reasoning_effort` on V4 returns 400; `developer` messages render as system messages; `/parse_function_call` also returns calls to tools outside `tools` with `tool_index` -1; requests that combine `tools` with `continue_final_message` return 400. Output parsing goes through deepseek-recipe when the DeepSeek reasoning or tool-call parser is set; sgl-router and sglang-server keep their Rust parsers for now: [#45315](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45315), [#45907](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45907), [#46219](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46219)
* **DeepSeek-V4.1 decoder SWA bounded replay is on by default** for supported CUDA configurations, including both PD roles. It is not numerically identical to full prefill. Pass `--no-enable-decoder-swa-bounded-replay` to keep full prefill, for example for RL rollouts whose logprobs must match the trainer: [#44403](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44403), [#45035](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45035)
* **DeepSeek-V4.1 defaults to MegaAttention under PD.** On SM100 / SM103 both PD roles now resolve `flashmla_mega` and the PD handshake checks the KV layout, so prefill and decode must run the same attention backend ([#45075](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45075)). Upgrade prefill and decode together, since an older decode cannot read the new handshake field; pass `--dsv4-attn-backend flashmla` on both roles to keep FlashMLA. Aggregated servers keep FlashMLA when attention is tensor-parallel across ranks: [#46263](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46263)
* **The `tokenspeed_mla` attention backend is removed.** `tokenspeed_mla` still starts as a deprecated alias for `cutedsl_mla` with a warning. To switch, pass `--attention-backend cutedsl_mla --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3`, plus `--speculative-attention-mode decode` with speculative decoding: [#44803](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44803)
* **`--speculative-skip-dp-mlp-sync` is removed.** Launch commands that pass it now fail with an unrecognized-argument error; drop the flag: [#45043](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45043)
* **The `kitchen_int8` diffusion quantization name is removed.** Use `convrot_int8`, deprecated in favor of it since v0.5.22: [#45706](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45706)
* **`SGLANG_ENABLE_UNIFIED_RADIX_TREE` is now ignored without a warning.** It already had no effect because the unified radix tree is the default; drop it from launch scripts: [#45090](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45090)
* **Legacy tar-format `.pt` checkpoints no longer load.** The unsafe `weights_only=False` pickle fallback is removed; convert such checkpoints to safetensors or zip-format `.pt` offline: [#42760](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42760)
* **Diffusion HTTP endpoints validate more strictly.** URL values for `upscaling_model_path` and `frame_interpolation_model_path` return 400, an unsupported `response_format` is rejected before generation, and a failed cloud upload returns 502 instead of 400: [#43585](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43585)
* **The first startup of a FlashInfer CUTLASS MoE server takes longer.** Startup autotune now also covers prefill sizes, so a server with no saved tuning results takes longer to become ready (on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on 8x H200, autotune goes from about 41 s to 177 s). Later startups reuse the saved results, and `--disable-flashinfer-autotune` skips tuning: [#43363](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43363)
* **Diffusion PNG responses are larger.** PNG output now defaults to zlib level 0: the same pixels, about 3x the bytes, several times faster to encode. Set `output_compression` to a value other than 75 to pick a level: [#45987](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45987)
* **sgl-router moved to the top-level `sgl-router/` directory.** Builds and scripts that point at `experimental/sgl-router/` must update the path ([#45414](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45414)); `--max-in-flight` is now `--max-inflight-requests`, and the old name still works as an alias: [#44950](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/44950)




## New Contributors

body:
# Highlights

*950 PRs from 245 contributors.*

## New models

| Model | Type | Cookbook |
|---|---|---|
| Clef / Clef Flash | LLM / VLM | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/Cloudflare/clef) |
| PPLX-Decider v1 / v1.1 | LLM / VLM | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/Perplexity/PPLX-Decider-v1.1-27B) |
| EmbeddingGemma 2 | LLM / VLM | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/Google/EmbeddingGemma2) |
| LLaDA2.2 | LLM / VLM | |
| HunyuanImage-3.0-Instruct | Diffusion | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/diffusion/Tencent/HunyuanImage3) |
| Kandinsky 6 / Kandinsky 6 SR | Diffusion | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/diffusion/Kandinsky/Kandinsky6) |
| Wan-Animate-2 | Diffusion | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/diffusion/Wan/Wan-Animate-2) |
| SANA-Video 2.0 | Diffusion | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/diffusion/SANA-Video/SANA-Video) |
| LLaDA-Image / LLaDA-Image-Turbo | Diffusion | |

## What's new

* DeepSeek-V4.1 gets up to 2.3x more throughput per GPU on H200, and now runs on AMD MI350X / MI355X with up to 1.9x throughput from DSpark ([#41251](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41251), [#41308](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41308)).
* Qwen3.8-Flash-Next decodes 12% faster on B200, and GLM-5.3-Flash with DFlash 10% faster on B300 ([#42175](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42175), [#42489](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42489)).
* MiMo-V2.6-Pro gets 1.85x decode throughput with DFlash on B300 ([#41886](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41886)).
* Models load 10x faster with the new InstantTensor loader ([#40453](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40453)).
* PD disaggregation gets up to 27% more throughput and half the p95 TTFT on long-prompt workloads ([#40703](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40703)).
* HiSparse now supports EAGLE and MTP for long-context serving with the KV cache in CPU memory ([#37771](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/37771)).
* GLM-5.2 and GLM-5.3 can now combine decode context parallelism with MTP, with up to 2.1x faster decoding on GLM-5.3 ([#43735](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43735)).
* SGLang now runs on Apple Silicon Macs with the standard PyTorch backend, alongside MLX ([#36780](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/36780)).
* MiniMax-H3 and Qwen-Image 2.1 now run in ComfyUI with SGLang Diffusion, which also loads community GGUF checkpoints and LoRAs ([#43504](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43504), [#43581](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43581), [#42556](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42556), [#39523](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39523), [#42174](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42174)).
* Important fix: Hybrid linear models could resume from wrong mamba states when speculative decoding and structured output were used together. Thanks to [@Wirick](https://github.com/Wirick) and Baseten for finding it ([#43029](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43029)).

## To upgrade

SGLang now requires Python 3.11 or newer.

```bash
uv pip install --prerelease=allow sglang==0.5.22
```

| Platform | Docker |
|---|---|
| NVIDIA (CUDA 13) | `docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.22` |
| AMD MI35x | `docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.22-rocm10-mi35x` |
| AMD MI30x | `docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.22-rocm10-mi30x` |
| Intel GPU | `docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.22-xpu` |
| Intel CPU | `docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.22-xeon` |

# Full Release Notes

## Speculative Decoding

* [RL][Spec] Introduce top-p mask capture for spec and add DFlash/DSpark impl: [#34201](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/34201)
* [HiSparse] Add speculative decoding support with multi-step KV cache swapping: [#37771](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/37771)
* [Kimi-K3][DCP][DSpark] fix eager mode nonetype crash due to no extend_prefix_lens: [#38991](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38991)
* [Spec][PP] Fix hybrid recurrent-state commit and micro-batch pairing under PP x speculative decoding: [#40001](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40001)
* [Spec] Reuse K3 auxiliary outputs across decode CUDA graph sizes: [#40159](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40159)
* [NVIDIA][MegaMoE] Fix the default spec decoding moe backend when the target model uses flashinfer megamoe: [#40772](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40772)
* fix(spec): enable Qwen3.5 EAGLE3 capture and streaming overlap: [#41154](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41154)
* [Qwen3.8-Flash-Next] Fuse QSA graph replay metadata across draft steps: [#41173](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41173)
* [Qwen3.8-Flash-Next] Fuse NEXTN verify and draft graph input preparation: [#41175](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41175)
* [HiSparse] fix: reject speculative decoding and mixed chunk at startup: [#41347](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41347)
* The sgalng api specs: [#41585](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41585)
* [Spec] Dspark support: [#41623](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41623)
* Fix XQA draft extend with FP8 KV cache in trtllm_mha: [#41656](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41656)
* [QSA] Enable breakable prefill CUDA graphs for text-only Qwen3.8 Flash-Next (capture-safe metadata, MTP side-channel padding): [#41729](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41729)
* [DFlash] Keep grouped-conv taps inside each request's block so NaN/Inf cannot leak across requests: [#41736](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41736)
* [DFlash2] Keep the greedy selector walk in range for all-NaN score rows: [#41737](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41737)
* [PD][Spec] Give a PD decode's first EAGLE draft step a proposal distribution: [#41783](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41783)
* [Fix] Pass the draft's attention ownership to DFLASH's eager LiLiCorr scope: [#41808](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41808)
* [Spec] Fix Qwen3.5 text model EAGLE3/DFLASH aux-layer capture: [#42002](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42002)
* [Spec][MegaMoE] Let the speculative draft choose its own W4A4 MXFP4 MegaMoE MMA type: [#42022](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42022)
* [Spec] LiLiCorr: named head MLPs and quantized head linears: [#42057](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42057)
* [Spec] Add opt-in block verification: [#42297](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42297)
* [Fix] Load a draft's tensor weight update from its deployment TP rank: [#42346](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42346)
* [Fix] Skip a draft's decode recapture when it owns no decode graph: [#42347](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42347)
* [Perf] Improve GLM-5.3-Flash DFlash decoding on B300 (decode 1091.9 to 1199.7 tok/s on 8x B300 at concurrency 1): [#42489](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42489)
* [DSpark] Mask uncommitted slots before commit-inject cache lookups: [#42624](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42624)

* Transformers 5.12.1 to 5.17.0 with tokenizers 0.22.2 to 0.23.2 ([#39012](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39012)), then 5.19.0: [#42784](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42784)
* FlashInfer 0.6.18 to 0.7.0.post1 with nvidia-cutlass-dsl 4.8.0 and quack-kernels 0.6.5 ([#40709](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40709)), then 0.7.1: [#43494](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43494)
* fastokens >= 0.3.2, now part of the `all` extra: [#43104](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43104)
* New optional extra `sglang[instanttensor]` (instanttensor >= 0.1.9): [#40453](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40453)
* Python 3.11+ is required ([#43021](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43021)); the CUDA image uses uv-managed Python 3.12: [#42612](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42612)
* Mooncake 0.3.13 to 0.3.13.post1: [#41678](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41678)
* Fix `pip install` by leaving the `multimodal_gen/.claude` symlink out of package data: [#41703](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41703)
* XPU: PyTorch 2.14.0+xpu, torchvision 0.29.0, sglang-kernel-xpu 0.3.0 to 0.4.0: [#42003](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42003)
* ROCm: AITER pin for gfx942 / gfx950 moves to `e7d2453f` ([#42023](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42023)) and MoRI to v1.2.4: [#43834](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43834)
* NPU: sgl-kernel-npu 2026.9.0.post9: [#43340](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43340)
* MUSA: torchada >= 0.1.90: [#41444](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41444)

## Breaking Changes & Upgrade Notes

* **SGLang requires Python 3.11 or newer.** On Python 3.10, `pip install sglang` does not fail; it resolves to the last release that supported 3.10. Move to Python 3.11+ (for example off the Ubuntu 22.04 system Python) to get this and later releases: [#43021](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43021)
* **`--enable-dp-attention` is deprecated; use `--attn-dp-size N`.** `--dp-size` now counts model replicas only. The old `--dp-size N --enable-dp-attention` still resolves to `--attn-dp-size N` with a warning; combining replicas with attention DP, or passing both spellings, is rejected at startup: [#41818](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41818). Under DeepSeek context parallelism, `--dp-size N` still means attention DP but now warns and will be rejected after 2026-12-31: [#42348](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42348)
* **`--disaggregation-decode-host-receive-threshold` flips its encoding.** `1` (the new default) disables host receive and `0` now means always receive on host. Configurations that passed `0` to disable it must pass `1`: [#43407](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43407)
* **`ChunkCache` is removed.** With `--disable-radix-cache`, full-attention, hybrid-SWA and Mamba models run `UnifiedRadixCache` in disabled mode and pure-SWA models run `PureSWARadixCache` ([#43198](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43198), [#43199](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43199), [#43200](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43200), [#42354](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42354), [#43201](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43201)). Streaming sessions now start only on `UnifiedRadixCache`; pure-SWA, FlexKV and plugin tree caches fail at startup with a "not verified" error ([#42295](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42295)), and beam search rejects Mamba models with `--disable-radix-cache` too ([#42354](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42354))
* **The `tc_piecewise` prefill CUDA graph backend is removed.** Passing `--cuda-graph-backend-prefill tc_piecewise` or a `tc_compiler` setting now raises an error; CUDA keeps `breakable` as the default prefill graph backend, and other platforms default to no prefill graph: [#42287](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42287)
* **Renamed and retired environment variables.** `SGLANG_AITER_MLA_DCP_DECODE_BACKEND` becomes `SGLANG_AITER_MLA_DECODE_BACKEND` and its default changes from `gluon` to `asm` ([#34537](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/34537)); `SGLANG_OPT_SWA_RELEASE_LEAF_LOCK_AFTER_WINDOW` becomes `SGLANG_OPT_RELEASE_PREFILL_SWA` ([#42657](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/42657)); the old names keep working with a deprecation warning. `SGLANG_DSPARK_FAST_SAMPLING`, `SGLANG_DSPARK_FOLDED_SAMPLING` and `SGLANG_DSPARK_OPT_FUSED_GREEDY_MARKOV` are deprecated and no longer do anything ([#43622](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43622), [#43668](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43668)), and `SGLANG_TRITON_PREFILL_TRUNCATION_ALIGN_SIZE` is deprecated: [#43444](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43444)
* **OpenAI chat responses changed in three small ways.** `tool_choice: "none"` no longer shows tool schemas to DeepSeek models ([#43006](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43006)), an absent `tool_calls` field is omitted instead of returned as `null` ([#43027](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43027)), and a stream keeps one `created` timestamp for its whole lifetime: [#43026](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43026)
* **`--enable-layernorm-sp` is rejected with pipeline parallelism.** It failed on the first prefill before: [#43458](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43458)
* **For model and plugin authors:** `ModelRunner.tp_group` is removed; read `get_parallel().tp_group` in the scope the code runs in ([#41817](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41817)). Unread placement attributes such as `model.tp_size` are gone; read `get_parallel()` ([#41812](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41812)). A model that declares stage boundaries and runs under pipeline parallelism must pass its shared stage declaration (`stage_facts`) to `make_layers` / `make_pp_layers`: [#43460](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43460)

body:
# Highlights

*779 PRs from 227 contributors.*

## New models

| Model | Type | Cookbook |
|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek-V4.1 Flash | LLM / VLM | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/DeepSeek/DeepSeek-V4_1) |
| GigaChat 3.5 | LLM / VLM | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/GigaChat/GigaChat3.5) |
| IQuest-Q1 | LLM / VLM | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/IQuestLab/IQuest-Q1) |
| MiMo-V2.6 / MiMo-V2.6-Pro | LLM / VLM | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/Xiaomi/MiMo-V2.6) |
| Ling-3.0-flash-VL | LLM / VLM | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/InclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash-VL) |
| DiffusionGemma | Diffusion | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/Google/DiffusionGemma) |
| Qwen-Image 2.1 | Diffusion | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/diffusion/Qwen-Image/Qwen-Image-2.1) |
| Anima Base v1.0 | Diffusion | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/diffusion/CircleStone/Anima) |
| Ming-Image 0.1 Design / Design-Layer | Diffusion | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/diffusion/inclusionAI/Ming-Image) |
| FLUX 3 Action | Diffusion | [link](https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/vla/FLUX/FLUX-3-Action) |

## Key features

* PD instances can switch between prefill and decode on the fly, no restart needed ([#28403](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/28403)).
* The prefix cache now runs on a Rust core by default ([#39627](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39627)).
* DeepSeek-V4.1 gets 22% faster first token on long prompts ([#40352](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40352)).
* Kimi K3 gets 20.6% higher prefill throughput in PD serving ([#40045](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40045)).
* GLM-5.3-Flash now runs on AMD MI355X, with FP8 / MXFP4 MoE and MTP speculative decoding ([#38546](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38546), [#39341](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39341), [#39778](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39778)).
* More accurate results under PP, DP attention, and CP, with layer communication now handled by SGLang ([guide](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/developer_guide/layer_boundary), [#41557](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41557)).
* New Decisions API (`/v1/decisions`) turns an LLM / VLM into a low-latency classifier and scorer ([docs](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/supported-models/decision_models), [#41208](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41208)).
* Score API (`/v1/score`) scores all candidates in one request ([#38965](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38965), [#41188](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41188)).
* Run MiniMax-H3 with SGLang Diffusion inside ComfyUI ([#35990](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/35990)).

## To upgrade

```bash
uv pip install --prerelease=allow sglang==0.5.21
```

| Platform | Docker |
|---|---|
| NVIDIA (CUDA 13) | [`docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.21`](https://hub.docker.com/r/lmsysorg/sglang/tags?name=v0.5.21) |
| AMD MI35x | [`docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.21-rocm10-mi35x`](https://hub.docker.com/r/lmsysorg/sglang/tags?name=v0.5.21-rocm10-mi35x) |
| AMD MI30x | [`docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.21-rocm10-mi30x`](https://hub.docker.com/r/lmsysorg/sglang/tags?name=v0.5.21-rocm10-mi30x) |
| Intel GPU | [`docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.21-xpu`](https://hub.docker.com/r/lmsysorg/sglang/tags?name=v0.5.21-xpu) |
| Intel CPU | [`docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.21-xeon`](https://hub.docker.com/r/lmsysorg/sglang/tags?name=v0.5.21-xeon) |

# Full Release Notes

## Speculative Decoding

* Pipeline parallelism x speculative decoding (EAGLE/MTP) compatibility: [#30775](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/30775)
* Support XQA backend for SpecDec verify: [#32269](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/32269)
* [Spec] Windowed draft-decode attention for built-in EAGLE / MTP drafts: [#32673](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/32673)
* Avoid materializing GDN QKV tensors during target verification: [#33778](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/33778)
* [Spec] Fix CDF boundary handling in `TreeSpeculativeSamplingTargetOnly`: [#35798](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/35798)
* [Spec] Add LiLiCorr: a candidate-lattice reranker for DFlash drafts: [#37462](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/37462)
* Add out-of-tree DFlash extension points: [#38740](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38740)
* [Spec] Add explicit prefill shared-read capability for plugins: [#39502](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39502)
* [Fix] Don't write conv state from the fused KDA verify kernel: [#39524](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39524)
* [Spec] Model-agnostic last-stage draft embedding under pipeline parallelism: [#39643](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39643)
* Use runtime token widths for Triton speculative verification: [#39859](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39859)
* avoid host sync in DSpark prefill slot expansion: [#40111](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40111)
* [Experimental] Preserve speculative decoding during prefill across DP ranks: [#40118](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40118)
* [Spec][PP] Launch extend microbatches before the spec output exchange: [#40499](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40499)
* [KDA] Enable ReplaySSM for GLM-5.3 Flash: [#40517](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40517)
* [LFM2-VL] Add DSpark speculative decoding (1.66x to 2.56x speedup at batch 1): [#40651](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40651)
* [Spec] Support DFLASH for Kimi K3: [#40794](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40794)
* [Fix] Reduce Nemotron MTP attention outputs once: [#40800](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40800)
* [Fix] Capture complete Nemotron auxiliary hidden states: [#40801](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40801)
* [Fix] Skip the DCP target-verify MLA kernel during FlashInfer autotune: [#41138](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41138)
* Fix mixed chunk prefill with DP speculative coordination: [#41179](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41179)
* [Fix] Plan NextN / MTP draft layers as one-layer models and fix the Bailing V2 NextN draft: [#41194](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41194)

## Piecewise & Breakable CUDA Graph

* [Fix] Preserve model runner contracts in prefill CUDA graphs: [#35452](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/35452)
* [DSV4][BCG] Optimize the heavy memory use of C4 Indexer when BCG is enabled (capture memory down 58% to 18 GB): [#36534](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/36534)
* [Fix] Don't free the multi-CTAs KV counter the decode graphs captured: [#39175](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39175)
* [CPU] Avoid prefill CP predicates during decode graph capture: [#39690](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39690)
* [Runtime] Add decode CUDA graph hooks for eager logits processing: [#40222](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40222)
* [Kimi K3] Fix CUDA graph stream explosion: [#40640](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40640)
* [DSpark] Fix draft CUDA graph stream explosion: [#40658](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40658)
* [Fix] Give the full prefill CUDA graph replay view the captured bucket's input_ids: [#40851](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40851)
* [DSA] Fix the pooled-indexer breakable prefill bridge under DP attention: [#41311](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41311)

## Attention Backends

* Allow attention layers to opt out of the prefill wrapper: [#40683](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40683)
* [Fix] Use cached prefix lengths for FlashInfer full-attention ragged prefill: [#40796](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40796)

## MoE & Expert Parallelism

* [3/N] elastic-ep: Recapture decode CUDA graphs after scale-up: [#33723](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/33723)
* Fix int4 MoE tuner config filename: [#35260](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/35260)
* [MegaMoE] Wire Qwen MoE blocks to DeepGEMM MegaMoE (MXFP4 and NVFP4 experts): [#38080](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38080)
* [Feature] Support BF16 and batch-invariant inference with DeepEP v2: [#38160](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38160)
* [Perf] Optimize w4a8 MoE for glm5.2 on H200: [#38220](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38220)
* [Fix] Guard FlashInfer CUTLASS MoE against 0-token inputs: [#38780](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38780)
* [Kernel] Add H20 block-FP8 MoE configs for GLM-5.3-Flash EP4/EP8: [#38913](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/38913)
* Accept MXFP8 dispatch in FlashInfer A2A TRT-LLM MoE: [#39613](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39613)
* [MoE] Honor swiglu_limit clamped activation in flashinfer_cutlass runner: [#39939](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39939)
* Support MXFP8 and deferred route weighting in DeepEP v2: [#40030](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40030)
* [MoE] Disable FlashInfer fused finalize by default for numerical accuracy: [#40105](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40105)
* [Fix] Fix top-1 MoE routing with non-unit scaling: [#40187](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40187)

## Breaking Changes & Upgrade Notes

* **The unified radix tree uses the Rust core by default.** Configurations the Rust core does not support fall back to Python automatically; set `SGLANG_UNIFIED_RADIX_TREE_CORE_BACKEND=python` to force the Python core everywhere: [#39627](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39627)
* **FlashInfer MoE fused finalize is off by default** for numerical accuracy. This costs some W4A4 MoE latency; set `SGLANG_FLASHINFER_MOE_FUSED_FINALIZE=1` to restore the fused atomic finalize: [#40105](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40105)
* **PD decode now defers KV release on abort by default** on the Mooncake and NIXL backends, holding pages until every prefill rank acks (30 s timeout, `SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_DEFERRED_DECODE_KV_RELEASE_TIMEOUT`). Set `SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_DEFERRED_DECODE_KV_RELEASE=False` to restore immediate release: [#41023](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/41023)
* **Request-supplied chat templates are rejected.** A `chat_template` key inside `chat_template_kwargs` on `/v1/chat/completions` or `/v1/tokenize` now returns an error unless the server starts with `--trust-request-chat-template`; other `chat_template_kwargs` are unchanged: [#28135](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/28135)
* **Deprecated endpoints, env vars, and aliases are removed.** Use `/model_info` instead of `/get_weight_version` and `/weight_version`, `/v1/loads` instead of `/get_load`, and `POST /hicache/storage-backend/clear` instead of `/clear_hicache_storage_backend`. `SGLANG_NSA_*` aliases give way to `SGLANG_DSA_*`, `SGLANG_ENABLE_SPEC_V2` is gone, `--elastic-ep-rejoin` becomes `--elastic-ep-join-mode recover`, `--kv-cache-dtype fp4_e2m1` becomes `fp4_mx_block16`, and `python -m sglang.bench_offline_throughput` / `sglang.bench_one_batch` move to `sglang.benchmark.offline_throughput` / `sglang.benchmark.one_batch`: [#40795](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40795)
* **Legacy radix cache implementations are removed.** The experimental C++ radix tree (`SGLANG_EXPERIMENTAL_CPP_RADIX_TREE`) is gone ([#40775](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40775)), and `SGLANG_ENABLE_UNIFIED_RADIX_TREE` no longer does anything, though it still prints a deprecation warning ([#40780](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40780)). Code importing `SWARadixCache`, `MambaRadixCache`, or `HiRadixCache` must move to `UnifiedRadixCache`: [#40313](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40313), [#40787](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40787)
* **Custom logit processors must return full-shape logits.** A `CustomLogitProcessor` that returned a reduced shape such as `(1, vocab)` and relied on broadcasting now raises at decode time. The built-in processors are unaffected: [#39234](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/39234)
* **RL weight updates run inside a session.** `update_weights_from_tensor` and `update_weights_from_distributed` must be called between `begin_weight_update()` and `end_weight_update()`. `UpdateWeightsFromTensorReqInput.disable_draft_model` is replaced by `selector="target"`, and `ChecksumInfo.parallelism_info` is now a list with one entry per role: [#40777](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40777)
* **Parallel-state getters are deprecated.** They are no longer re-exported from `sglang.srt.distributed`; read groups through `get_parallel()` (for example `get_parallel().tp_group`) or import from `parallel_state` directly: [#40342](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40342), [#40344](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40344), [#40707](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40707)
* **Ascend A2 (910b) images are no longer published.** Release and nightly images ship for A3 and 950 (A5) only, on CANN 9.1.0 with Python 3.12: [#40524](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40524)
